## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

Record relevant results: server tests, real SSH integration tests, Ruff, distribution builds and installation checks. CI must pass before merging.

## Compatibility

Describe configuration, CLI or API changes and migration steps. Write “None” if unchanged.

- [ ] Tests and documentation cover the change.
- [ ] No credentials, live configuration or private diagnostics are included.
